The 27-analyst mean is $241.82, +29.7% vs the 2026-08-19 close of $186.45 (universe_scan.prices_meta ANET, daily_bar); Barclays raised its target to $289 on 2026-08-06. Thirty-day EPS revisions are +13.11% (scan). The stock pulled back 13.2% from its 20-day high, RSI 50.2, still above the 50- and 200-day, 3-month relative strength vs SPY +26.6% while 1-month is only +4.0% — a leader resetting, not a laggard bounce. Wednesday's session low was $184.51 and the close $186.45 held it; pre-market 2026-08-20 still sat $185.25-$188.23. Stack differential: Arista sells Ethernet switching and EOS software for AI data-center fabrics (Microsoft and Meta its largest customers) versus Cisco's campus/enterprise mix (CSCO 3-month RS vs SPY -8.9%, still below its 50-day) and Broadcom merchant silicon. Demand driver is networking, not the hyperscaler_server_capex book that produced every realized loss. Sized at ~$100 as an 80% starter against an 8.8% stop.

proposal.risk_map: This fails if (1) the $12.6B FY2026 raise was the high-water mark — early tell is a cut below $12.0B or a >5% 30-day EPS revision from the $3.64 current-year estimate; (2) Wednesday's $184.51 low fails and the stock closes through $184, proving this washout is distribution, which is the live risk because yesterday's bar was a -3.48% / -2.9% down-gap (retained_pct 1.49) on rvol 0.71; (3) Microsoft/Meta concentration (Arista's two largest customers) shows up as an AI-capex pause that hits Ethernet fabrics first; (4) CEO Andreas Bechtolsheim sold $43.9M of common on 2026-07-14 and momentum_health is already softening, so a factor washout can tag an 8.8% stop in one session. Early tell: a close back through $184.00 on rising volume.
proposal.variant_perception: CONSENSUS: 27 analysts rate it a strong buy (mean 1.30) with a $241.82 target, +29.7% from the $186.45 2026-08-19 close (universe_scan.analyst_ratings), and the Street is modeling 40.7% forward revenue growth at a 36x forward P/E that the scan tags cheap_vs_growth (PEG 0.89). This week's networking washout and Citi's $215 target (2026-08-06) are being read as the AI-Ethernet re-rate being done. MY VIEW: the 13.2% pullback to the $184.51 low that Wednesday held is the market treating a company that just raised FY2026 to $12.6B (40% growth) as if the move is finished, while +13.11% 30-day EPS revisions and still-positive 3-month RS vs SPY (+26.6%) say the post-print drift has not been paid. MECHANISM: Street NTM models are multiple-driven at ~36-51x, so they fade any pause as 'the $12.6B raise is in the price.' What they underweight is the sequential: $3.036B going to ~$3.3B in Q3 is still ~43% YoY, with TTM free cash flow $3.89B and $13.34B cash against no debt (Yahoo key statistics as of 2026-08-18). RESOLUTION: if ANET has not closed above $205 (halfway from $187.50 toward the $241.82 mean) by 2026-09-25, the throwback re-rate is not happening and I exit well before the estimated 2026-11-03 print.
